# validate

> Validate the structure of a [JSON Patch][json-patch] ([RFC 6902][rfc-6902]) operations array.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var validate = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/validate' );
```

#### validate( operations )

Validates the structure of a JSON Patch operations array. Returns `null` if valid, or an `Error` describing the first validation failure.

```javascript
var err = validate( [ { 'op': 'add', 'path': '/foo', 'value': 1 } ] );
// returns null

err = validate( [ { 'op': 'add', 'path': '/foo' } ] );
// returns <Error>
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   Validates structural requirements only (valid `op`, required fields), not path semantics.
-   `add`, `replace`, `test` require a `value` field.
-   `move`, `copy` require a `from` field.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->
